referenceFunction.generalComment: Data are based on information in a US-EPA LCA study about LCD and CRT production. The data represent the respective efforts for a 15-inch LCD computer screen, as it is produced in Japan.; UUID: 32c22570-83a1-3f25-a2fb-9943fbdac093
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This module includes the material and energy efforts as well as the related emissions (air/water) and waste amounts for the production of polarizer, liquid crystals as well as the patternin of color filters on the LCD panel. Estimations for infrastructure and transport of the raw materials are included as well.
referenceFunction.name: Panel components, at plant

geography.text: Data from literature (based on information from Japanese producers) – used as data for the global production average
